name: steppe_deck
notes: The chalk steppe an arena is sunk into, after Windbarrow's downs: short turf with the chalk coming through, heather and lichen and nothing taller, starlings flocking over it, crows and an eagle in the sky. It dresses the plain round a buried arena, not the arena itself; what is inside comes from the materials the steppe style paints on the structure.

sound.notes: Open downland round the arena: the wind never stops.
